title: A map model: data/map_models/<model>/data.json
description: A map model of archive a/0/0/8, whose geometry, materials and placed props are model.glb next to this file and whose collision terrain is its terrain CSVs. tools/data/map_model_data.py packs them in the order of data/constants/map_models.txt. A string value is the name of a constant from data/constants/.

texture_set.description: The texture set the model's materials bind to, where the map matrices' areas or the resource names show it, or null where they don't. Only a model with one can have its texture bindings edited, since the set the game loads depends on the area

texture_preview.description: For a model with no texture_set, one of the sets that has every texture and palette it names, which its GLB shows in Blender

transformed.description: Set when the GLB's positions went through the model's node transforms on export, which the packer reverses
